title: ack_always Receiver does not track received FCNs per window, allows duplicates at wrong positions
description:
## Location
- /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_always.rs lines 334-397

## Problem
The receiver tracks received fragments with a bitmap:
```rust
self.recv_bitmap |= 1u64 << frag.fcn;
```

But it does not prevent the same FCN from overwriting a previously stored tile at a different position. Combined with the sequential offset issue, this creates a complex failure mode.

Additionally, when handling window transitions:
```rust
if frag.window != self.window && !frag.is_all_1() {
    self.window = frag.window;
    self.recv_bitmap = 0;
}
```

The bitmap is reset but the buffer offset is not. If a retransmitted fragment from a previous window arrives, it will be written at the wrong offset.

## What Goes Wrong
1. Receive FCN 6 at offset 0 (correct)
2. Receive FCN 5 at offset 10 (correct)  
3. Receive retransmitted FCN 6 again at offset 20 (WRONG - should be at offset 0)
4. Buffer is now corrupted: [tile6_v1][tile5][tile6_v2] instead of [tile6][tile5][tile6_copy]

## Suggested Fix
1. Check bitmap before storing: if bit already set, skip or verify consistency
2. Calculate buffer position from FCN rather than using sequential offset
3. When window changes, also reset offset to window_base * TILE
close_reason: Changed from single recv_bitmap to bitmaps[4] array to track FCNs per window and detect duplicates
